best: The 3V3 buck and the four-switch power stage read as clean textbook left-to-right drawings, and titled blocks with short notes say what each section does.
worst: USB port sheets are tiny parts spread over a very large page with a big empty lower-left area, and the BQ25756 and TPS25751 connect to their support parts mostly by name-only stubs and long, wandering wires
Text overlaps: R105/C105, TH101 against the PACK_P label, R445/R446 labels, J120/J116 labels, R111/Q102 names
Many parts float alone tied only by labels (D101, J117/J119, TP301, Q409, R432, EN_5V1, U402 EEPROM, U405 support caps away from their pins) instead of sitting at the pin they serve
